title: A Rewind Step on a Marked Cell
statement: Let $S$ be a deterministic Boolean Turing machine, $A$ a nondeterministic Boolean Turing machine, $x$ a Boolean input, and $m$ a natural number. If the yard tape containing $m$ consecutive true symbols has value true at an integer position $z$, then one step of the host machine in phase $	ext{rew2}$ moves the input head one position left and the yard head from $z$ to $z-1$, leaving the phase, all other tape contents and head positions, and the output unchanged.
